name.value: Ocean Breeze Executive Bed and Breakfast

description.value: Ocean Breeze is a boutique European-style bed and breakfast on the North Shore of Vancouver, operating since 1992 with waterfront views of Vancouver Harbour. The property is 11 minutes from downtown Vancouver via the scenic SeaBus and sits within walking distance of craft breweries, restaurants, and the Shipyards Night Market. All rooms include private bathrooms and the B&B serves a full hot breakfast with specialty items like smoked salmon omelettes, eggs benedict, and blueberry pancakes.
